title: Credit clean category fixtures only after routeability-safe geometry and manufacturing export
rootCause: New category fixture definitions existed, but the quick readiness scorer did not include their clean manufacturing evidence. Initial compact geometries also produced DRC issues because the generic fixture topology was over-constrained.
fix: Use routeability-safe geometry fallback for alpha category proofs, rerun the fixture factory, require DRC/ERC/unconnected/forbidden-via clean results, then add the clean cached fixtures to the quick readiness evidence set.
